description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeActionSummaryDao class, which contains methods for querying and retrieving various HR-related data such as interview schedules, performance reviews, and self-review counts within the OrangeHRM system. The class interacts with database entities and constructs complex query builders tailored for employee performance and review management.

classes.name: EmployeeActionSummaryDao
classes.description: Data access object responsible for retrieving HR management data related to employee performance, reviews, and interviews within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getActionableScheduledInterviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of scheduled interviews for candidates with specified IDs who are in the 'INTERVIEW SCHEDULED' status and whose associated vacancies are active.

methods.name: getPendingAppraisalReviewCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of pending appraisal reviews based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getPendingAppraisalReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a query builder wrapper for fetching pending appraisal reviews, optionally filtered by reviewer employee number.

methods.name: getActionableReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a complex query to fetch performance reviews suitable for action, filtered by review group, employee status, and review statuses.

methods.name: getPendingSelfReviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of self reviews pending for a specific employee, filtered by review statuses.

methods.name: getSelfReviewQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Creates a query builder for fetching self reviews of a specific employee, optionally filtered by employee number.

methods.name: getPendingSelfReviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves the IDs of pending self reviews for an employee based on the current filter parameters.
